map.计算氧合指数 P/F 比值，按 Berlin 标准评估 ARDS 严重程度；可选: Compute the P/F oxygenation ratio and grade ARDS severity by the Berlin criteria; mean airway pressure can optionally be entered to calculate the oxygenation index OI.
map.📖 查看「氧合指数（PaO2/FiO2）计算 使用指南」: 📖 View the Oxygenation Index (PaO2/FiO2) Calculation user guide
map.P/F 比值与 Berlin ARDS 分级: P/F ratio and Berlin ARDS grading
map.高死亡率，需俯卧位/ECMO: High mortality; prone positioning / ECMO needed
Formula: P/F = PaO2 / FiO2 (FiO2 as a decimal, e.g. 40% = 0.4); OI = (MAP x FiO2 x 100) / PaO2; OI >40 suggests severe respiratory failure.
map.⚠️ P/F 受 PEEP、海拔、血红蛋白影响；SpO2-based 估算 P/: P/F is affected by PEEP, altitude and hemoglobin; SpO2-based P/F estimation is less accurate at high SpO2, so arterial blood gas is preferred.
map.MAP 13、FiO₂ 0.40、PaO₂ 80：OI=(13×40)/80=6: MAP 13, FiO2 0.40, PaO2 80: OI=(13x40)/80=6.5; OI >10 suggests severe.
map.无创时以 SpO₂/FiO₂ 替代，SF<315 近似 PF<300。: Noninvasive substitute: SpO2/FiO2; SF <315 approximates PF <300.
map.用于计算 OI 氧合指数: Used to calculate the OI oxygenation index
map.PaCO₂ 判读：>45 mmHg 通气不足（CO₂ 潴留）｜<35 过度通气｜: PaCO₂ interpretation: >45 mmHg hypoventilation (CO₂ retention) | <35 hyperventilation | otherwise normal
map.氧合指数 P/F 与 OI 计算: Oxygenation Index: P/F and OI Calculation
map.P/F 比值 = PaO₂ ÷ (FiO₂ ÷ 100)（FiO₂ 以百分数输入: P/F ratio = PaO₂ ÷ (FiO₂ ÷ 100) (enter FiO₂ as a percentage)
map.Berlin 分级：P/F > 400 正常｜>300 轻度 ARDS｜>200: Berlin grading: P/F > 400 normal | >300 mild ARDS | >200 moderate ARDS | otherwise severe ARDS
map.重度处置：俯卧位通气、肌松、必要时 ECMO: Severe management: prone positioning, neuromuscular blockade and ECMO if needed
map.氧合指数 OI = (MAP × FiO₂) ÷ PaO₂（主要用于新生儿/儿科: Oxygenation index OI = (MAP × FiO₂) ÷ PaO₂ (mainly for neonates and children)
map.OI 分级：<5 正常｜<8 轻度呼吸衰竭｜<16 中度｜<40 重度｜≥40: OI grading: <5 normal | <8 mild respiratory failure | <16 moderate | <40 severe | ≥40 critical (often an ECMO indication)
map.约束：PaO₂ 须 > 0，FiO₂ 须 ≥ 21%: Constraints: PaO₂ must be > 0 and FiO₂ must be ≥ 21%
map.P/F 区间条按 ÷500 归一化，标注 200/300/400 分界: P/F bars are normalized by ÷500, with 200/300/400 thresholds marked
